Marker-guided fill0 positive · 0 exclusions

Navigation: wheel steps the slice in the view under the pointer; in Navigate, click moves the 3D cursor, drag adjusts WL (vertical) / WW (horizontal). Shift + drag zooms toward the 3D cursor in all views; right-drag adjusts WL/WW in either mode. The crosshair is a fine gray dash. In Segment, left-click edits at the clicked voxel without moving the 3D cursor or changing slices. Add at least three local CT seed spheres around one target, optionally place blue Exclude markers at regions that are not blood, then press Propose fill. Yellow is an uncommitted local HU/geometry suggestion: inspect nearby slices in all views before Accept preview or Discard preview. Exclusions block new voxels near their locations but do not erase existing mask. Undo reverses an accepted proposal. Grow/shrink hold previews the local edit; release commits. Switch to Navigate for ordinary left-drag windowing. HU is not a blood classifier.
